title: Insurance Claim Repairs Repair Class Assignment
content:
**Basis.** The repair class of an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is assigned once, when the repair order opens, from the estimate submitted for authorization and the vehicle record, and is not changed by later supplements.

**Structural repairs.** A repair with structural operations takes the structural class matching the body structure on the vehicle record: Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair for an aluminum-intensive structure, Certified Structural Claim Repair for a mixed-material structure, and Structural Claim Repair for a steel unibody or body-on-frame structure.

**Non-structural repairs.** A repair without structural operations takes Express Claim Repair when its estimated labor hours are within the Express labor-hours ceiling and the vehicle was drivable at the estimate, Standard Claim Repair when they are within the Standard ceiling, and Major Claim Repair otherwise.

**Effect of the class.** The class fixes every per-class term of Insurance Claim Repairs, including the warranty plan issued at delivery.

**Insurer's figures.** The insurer's deductible, coverage type and claim number are taken from the insurer's assignment exactly as stated and are never altered by the desk.

**Center capability.** The repair class applies only where its structural-operations, manufacturer-certified-procedure and dedicated-aluminum-bay requirements can be met by the assigned center; the desk never downgrades a class to fit a center.

## Decision table

| Structural operations on the estimate | Body structure on the vehicle record | Estimated labor hours | Drivable at the estimate | Class |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | aluminum-intensive | any | any | Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair |
| Yes | mixed-material | any | any | Certified Structural Claim Repair |
| Yes | steel unibody or body-on-frame | any | any | Structural Claim Repair |
| No | any | within the Express ceiling | Yes | Express Claim Repair |
| No | any | within the Express ceiling | No | Standard Claim Repair |
| No | any | above the Express ceiling, within the Standard ceiling | any | Standard Claim Repair |
| No | any | above the Standard ceiling | any | Major Claim Repair |

## Worked cases (hypothetical estimates, using the class ceilings of 10.0 hours for Express and 30.0 hours for Standard)

1. Non-structural, 9.5 hours, drivable: within the Express ceiling and drivable — Express Claim Repair.
2. Non-structural, 9.5 hours, not drivable: the Express condition fails on drivability; 9.5 hours is within the Standard ceiling — Standard Claim Repair.
3. Non-structural, 30.0 hours: equal to the Standard ceiling and so within it — Standard Claim Repair.
4. Non-structural, 31.0 hours: above both ceilings — Major Claim Repair.
5. A supplement later adds 25.0 hours to case 1: the class stays Express Claim Repair, because supplements never change the class.
